Title: Vihaan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Vihaan - 11 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Neeta - 39 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Nitin - 37 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater
4. Pihu - 10 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Vihaan stands in the living room. Neeta and Nitin stand near him.]

Nitin: "Let's do something fun today."

[Vihaan opens the door and goes out.]

Nitin: "Yes, of course."

[Vihaan slams the door shut.]

Nitin: "And then?"

[Vihaan opens the window.]

Neeta (laughing): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
